entities.title: IEEE 754 floating-point arithmetic
entities.summary: The standard that makes + − × ÷ and square root give the same bits everywhere.
entities.relevance: dmath.ts relies on it: the basic operations and Math.sqrt are correctly rounded, so every JavaScript engine computes the same series.
entities.citation: IEEE Std 754, Standard for Floating-Point Arithmetic

entities.title: mulberry32
entities.relevance: A small 32-bit generator built from Math.imul and shifts, whose state is kept in the game, so a seed replays a game exactly in every engine.
